CustomField.label: Last updated by twin
CustomField.description: Date and time of the most recent write to this opportunity made by a Claude digital twin. Set only by the twin's CRM-update skill, in the same update as the change itself. Field History tracking is on, so each twin write leaves its own history row beside the changes it made.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set by the Claude twin when it updates this opportunity. If the time is recent, the twin made the change shown in the field history.
